eval_name: A clean run files nothing — no invented findings
prompt: The /develop run for task-090 just finished. Every gate passed first try, the review came back clean, and nobody hit any friction. Run the end-of-run retro protocol for run-id develop-task-090 and report.
expectations: No issue was added to the known-issues ledger
No work-item was appended to the backlog
No finding was fabricated into the inbox
the issue files, the index's issue lines, the backlog and the feedback state were mutated only by the CLI, never by hand
The report's Filed section states that nothing was filed
forbidden_expectations: The skill over-fired and invented a defect on a clean run
